# `mise dotfiles conflicts`

- **Usage:** `mise dotfiles conflicts [FLAGS] [PATH]…`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/dotfiles/conflicts.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/dotfiles/conflicts.rs)

Compare both sides of a sync conflict

Prints a unified diff from this machine's saved version to the version fetched from the origin. `--difftool` opens the comparison in Git's configured diff tool; when `diff.tool` is unset, Git falls back to `merge.tool`. `--json` prints one record per conflict, with the commands that resolve it, and writes nothing. `--sides` writes each side's plaintext into a private directory and reports those paths. Encrypted sides are decrypted before a diff, a diff tool, or a side file sees them. This command changes neither saved side. Resolve a conflict with `mise dot pull --take-remote` or `--keep-local`.

## Arguments
- **`[PATH]…`** — Only inspect these conflicted paths

## Flags
- **`--difftool`** — Open the comparison in Git's configured diff or merge tool
- **`--tool <TOOL>`** — Use this Git diff tool instead of the configured default
- **`--json`** — Print one JSON record per conflict, with the commands that resolve it

  Writes nothing on its own. Each record names the live path, the history path, the kind, any detail, whether the saved object is encrypted, and each side's mode. It never includes file content.
- **`--sides <DIR>`** — Write each side's plaintext into a new directory and report the paths

  `DIR` must not exist. mise creates it at mode 0700 and each side file at mode 0600. An existing path, including a directory or symlink, is refused. Requires `--json`.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Examples

Show every conflict

```
mise dot conflicts
```

Show one conflicted file

```
mise dot conflicts ~/.zshrc
```

Open the comparison in Git's diff tool

```
mise dot conflicts --difftool ~/.zshrc
```

Use a specific diff tool

```
mise dot conflicts --difftool --tool meld ~/.zshrc
```

Print each conflict and the commands that resolve it

```
mise dot conflicts --json
```

Write each side's plaintext beside the JSON handoff

```
mise dot conflicts --json --sides /tmp/sides
```
